adaptations: Pure format helpers extracted; no upstream hooks/stores/media/fetch/Agent
PptxGenJS installed 4.0.1 supports custom geometry points; hex colors omit #
SVG paths normalized absolute/HV/ST before original parser, no silent omitted elements
Safe formula raster via existing local math host, explicitly noneditable; no raw model HTML
